findings_qualitative.value: CS J=5-4 is not detected in any CO clump; the stacked spectrum shows only a marginal narrow feature within the CO velocity range

evidence.quote: We did not detect CS $J$=5$\rightarrow$4 in any of the CO clumps.
This marginal feature is within the velocity range of the CO $J$=2$\rightarrow$1 line, and shows a much narrower line width.

findings_qualitative.value: The lack of CS emission may result from lower average cloud density, low carbon and sulfur abundance, and photodissociation

evidence.quote: Weak CS emission may be result of on average lower density of a molecular cloud at very low metallicity.

claims.hypothesis: Dense gas traced by CS J=5-4 is detectable in CO-bright clumps of DDO 70
claims.experiment: ALMA CS J=5-4 spectra extracted from five CO clumps
claims.result: No CS detection in any clump
claims.finding: CS is not detected where CO is strong

evidence.quote: We did not detect CS $J$=5$\rightarrow$4 in any of the CO clumps.

claims.hypothesis: DDO 70 follows the L'CS-LIR and L'CS-SFR relations of local star-forming galaxies and Galactic dense cores
claims.experiment: Stack CS spectra, take 3-sigma upper limit and compare with refit literature relations
claims.result: The upper limit lies above the 1-sigma upper bound of the linear correlation
claims.finding: CS emission is weak for the given IR luminosity and SFR, a possible CS deficit at low metallicity

evidence.quote: The 3-$\sigma$ upper limit of CS $J$=5$\rightarrow$4 of DDO 70 is located above the 1-$\sigma$ upper bound of the linear correlation, which may imply a deficit of CS molecules at such low metallicity.

claims.hypothesis: The CO J=1-0/CS J=5-4 ratio of DDO 70 differs from IR bright galaxies
claims.experiment: Assume CO J=2-1/J=1-0 ~1 and compare CO/CS ratio versus IR luminosity with literature data
claims.result: Lower limit on CO J=1-0/CS J=5-4
claims.finding: Ratio lower limit is consistent with IR bright galaxies

evidence.quote: The lower limit of CO $J$=1$\rightarrow$0/CS $J$=5$\rightarrow$4 of DDO 70 is consistent with IR bright galaxies.

claims.hypothesis: Low density, low C and S abundance, or photodissociation explains weak CS
claims.result: Several mechanisms may contribute; dust-depletion explanation is inconsistent with the observation

evidence.quote: In the end, it is still unknown that whether these two effects can fully contribute to such low luminosity and whether there exists other dominant physical mechanisms.
